defects: Missing hypothesis [OpensMeasurableSpace α], which is required to relate the topology on α to its measurable space structure so that continuity implies measurability
Missing hypothesis [BorelSpace γ], required so that γ's measurable space is the Borel σ-algebra generated by its topology; without it 'continuous on s' does not yield 'measurable on s'
Without these two typeclasses the statement is strictly weaker in hypotheses than the gold and is not a theorem in general (fails for topological/measurable space pairs with incompatible structures)
